title: Character Creation w/ Openpose Controlnet in Stable Pixel (Desktop)
author: stable_pixel

comments.author: stable_pixel
comments.body:
Hey! Short update. Added the functionality to upload custom poses within Stable Pixel. I used [this website](https://huggingface.co/spaces/AIARTCHAN/openpose_editor) to create them. What do you think?

In case you're interested for more, sign up [here](https://forms.office.com/e/CuuDxzQ1NW)!

comments.author: _stevencasteel_
comments.body:
Great upgrade from last time! Marketing wise, that character example is a bit derpy. Might be better to show game ready asset poses. Even better, a sprite sheet and animation example.  Like a walk cycle.

Does the character retain consistency? It looks like text to image only? Without Img2Img, its usability decreases quite a bit.

Still immensely useful for quick-starting the creative process though.

replies.author: stable_pixel
replies.body:
True, it looks kinda derpy :D Honestly I just wanted to share a quick demo and didn‘t really think about that too much.

Regarding your ideas on img2img, this is not implemented yet. I‘ll focus on refining the current workflow and dedicate some time towards coming up with a way to reference previous image generations.

btw, thanks for always providing your thoughtful input!

comments.author: DreamNotDeferred
comments.body: Thanks for the update, keep up the good work.
